description: Live run-tool E2E tool list for the Navigation Tools extension. Driven by tests/e2e/run_tool_e2e.py from the e2e-godot CI leg against a connected headless editor + a local gamedev-mcp-server. Each entry is one real assertion: a regression in the tool turns the CI leg red.
notes: The editor tools (region-create/region-set-mesh/agent-create/agent-configure/link-create/get) resolve nodes relative to the edited scene root, so the 'setup' phase opens a 3D scene first via the core godot_mcp 'rql-mutate' tool (editor | call NewScene), and the entries below exercise the 3D variants (NavigationRegion3D/NavigationAgent3D/NavigationLink3D). navigation-defaults is pure-managed and needs no scene. The 'expect' substrings are matched against godot-cli's compact --raw JSON; they assert structured fields produced by the extension's own code (Kind/Dimension/Radius/…) rather than node.GetClass() casing.
